trigger.label: reports a milk or dairy allergy

userMessage: Whey is milk-derived. We'll route you to a plant-based protein instead - and if this is a true milk-protein allergy rather than lactose intolerance, please confirm with a clinician.

review.note: Milk-protein allergy and lactose intolerance are different things with different consequences. Lactose intolerance should route to isolate or plant protein without escalation; true milk-protein allergy escalates. The current trigger conflates them and needs expert splitting.
